summary: Switching sections destroys VirusesPage state: scan results, journal and running scan are lost; a second scan can start while the first runs
evidence: App.svelte:65-70 if/else chain unmounts VirusesPage on section change; VirusesPage.svelte:21-27 keeps state locally
failure_scenario: Start scan of a large folder, click VPN then Вирусы: Проверка shows ready and Начать is enabled; journal and findings are empty. A second scan_start can run concurrently (backend guard UNVERIFIED).
